name: smaran-ai-codex
description: A coding agent that reads your project, changes files, runs commands and reads the results — one step at a time, in view.

commands.title: SMARAN.AI: Give the agent a task
SMARAN.AI: Write tests for this file
SMARAN.AI: Fix the problems in this file

smaran.ollamaUrl.markdownDescription: Where Ollama is, for running a model on this machine. Only used when `#smaran.provider#` is empty.

smaran.provider.markdownDescription:
Which model runs the agent. Empty means Ollama on this machine; `lmstudio` means LM Studio's local server. Both run without a key and send nothing off the machine, and whichever models you already have there are the ones offered.

This matters more than any other setting. A small local model will follow the loop and still lose track of what it has done; the difference between a 3B model and a large one is not something the extension can make up for.

smaran.model.markdownDescription: The model to use. Pick it from the Setup tab, which lists what the chosen provider actually has rather than guessing.

smaran.apiKeys.deprecationMessage: Keys now live in your operating system's keychain. Anything here is moved there once, and this is emptied. Use the Setup tab in the panel.
smaran.apiKeys.markdownDescription:
Your provider keys. They stay in your VS Code settings and are sent to the provider you chose and nowhere else — there is no server of ours in between. If you already entered keys in the SMARAN.AI app, those are picked up too, without the app needing to run.

**Free tiers:** [Groq](https://console.groq.com/keys) · [Google Gemini](https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey) · [OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai/keys) · [NVIDIA NIM](https://build.nvidia.com/)

**Paid:** [Anthropic](https://console.anthropic.com/settings/keys) · [OpenAI](https://platform.openai.com/api-keys) · [DeepSeek](https://platform.deepseek.com/api_keys)

enumDescriptions: Explores the code and tells you what it would do. Changes nothing at all.
Asks before every change and every command.
Changes files on its own. Still asks before running a command.
Works on its own, and pauses for anything that looks risky.
smaran.mode.markdownDescription:
How much the agent may do without asking. Also switchable from the panel.

This is enforced where the tool would run, not asked of the model — in Plan mode the tools that change things refuse, whatever the model tries.

smaran.lmStudioUrl.markdownDescription: Where LM Studio's local server is. Start it from LM Studio's Developer tab. Only used when `#smaran.provider#` is `lmstudio`.

smaran.usageReporting.markdownDescription: Send a count of installs and launches. Four fields: a random id for this installation, the word `install` or `launch`, the word `vscode`, and the version. No file, task, project name, path or key is ever sent. Turn it off and nothing is sent at all.
